decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The external surfaces of the installation shall be maintained in a colour painted to match the existing roof.
Condition : 2 - The installation shall be maintained in accordance with the manufacturers instructions, with the carbon filters changed frequently so as to avoid emissions of smells.
Condition : 3 - The extraction system shall be switched off at midnight or at close of business, whichever is the earlier.

Condition : 4 - The installation shall be screened in accordance with a scheme to be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning  Authority and such screening measures shall be completed within three months of the approval of the submitted details or such extended time as shall first be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
description: Retention of ventilation system to restaurant
